create_visual_overlay_renderer: create an OrchestratorRenderer instance with a SceneReferenceImage to initialize the visual overlay canvas
load_scene_objects_from_work_unit: load scene objects from an Orchestrator WorkUnit into the renderer for overlay processing
add_single_overlay_object: add a single DrawCircleIcon, DrawArrowIcon, DrawSquareIcon, DrawTriangleIcon, or DrawContainer to the overlay
render_overlay_with_image: render all overlay objects onto an optional base image and return the result
export_overlay_image: export the rendered overlay image as a PIL Image, numpy array, or JPEG/PNG bytes
